scripts.deploy:demo:interactive: npx cdk deploy AgentEnforcerStack DemoStack --context demoMode=interactive --context uiDomain=demo.agent-enforcer.com
scripts.build:rpm:custom: npx cdk deploy RpmBuilderStack --context buildTimestamp=$(date +%s) --context builderAmi=${AMI_ID}
scripts.deploy:all: npx cdk deploy AgentEnforcerStack DemoStack RpmBuilderStack --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:all:demo: npx cdk deploy AgentEnforcerStack DemoStack RpmBuilderStack --require-approval never --context demoMode=interactive --context uiDomain=demo.agent-enforcer.com
scripts.destroy:all: npx cdk destroy AgentEnforcerStack DemoStack RpmBuilderStack --force
